fusions.name: Letter Opener
fusions.desc: Slides a hidden blade from the spine that deals 28 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Razor Fan
fusions.desc: Fans out razor-edged pages in a cone 4 tiles ahead that deals 7 damage to everything in it. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Sharp Rebuttal
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Keen Deckle
fusions.desc: Your slashing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
